title: Living Specification Governance & Continuous Codebase Drift Detection: AST Differential Auditing across Implementations and Checked-In Specs
author: Jim Quinn, Elise Ewing, Dave Rensin (Google LLC, 2026; synthesized by Brain Harness)

claims.assertion: Technical design specifications checked into source control (docs/designs/) must serve as living, verified contracts; periodic automated drift detection comparing specs to current source code prevents architectural rot.

Codebase drift must be categorized into four discrete divergence taxonomies: Missing Features (planned logic absent), Incomplete Models (missing fields in dataclasses/protos), Logic Shortcuts (hardcoded values replacing dynamic flows), and Architectural Divergence (unapproved patterns/libraries).

Drift reports must be differential and noise-free, reporting strictly divergences without reciting matching or conforming code, outputting 'No drift detected' when code perfectly satisfies specification.
